title: Extract and test validateBackupFile utility
description: The validateBackupFile function lives inside use-backup-restore.ts as a private closure and cannot be tested in isolation. Extract it to src/utils/validate-backup-file.ts, import it back in the hook, then write exhaustive tests. This function is the gatekeeper for the restore flow and incorrect validation could silently corrupt congregation data.
steps: Move the validateBackupFile function body verbatim from src/hooks/use-backup-restore.ts into the new file
Export the function and the BackupData type reference
In src/hooks/use-backup-restore.ts, replace the inline definition with: import { validateBackupFile } from '@/utils/validate-backup-file'
Write tests covering all validation branches
Run bun test to confirm all pass and no regressions
tests: cities containing a non-object entry returns false
City with missing id returns false
City with missing name returns false
Map with missing id returns false
Map with missing city_id returns false
Map with missing name returns false
Map with missing address returns false
Empty cities and maps arrays returns true (valid empty backup)
acceptanceCriteria: src/hooks/use-backup-restore.ts imports from the new utility (no duplicate definition)
All 16 tests pass with bun test
